sql: SELECT fm.id, fm.source, fm.name, fm.llm_sport_category AS cat, fm.category AS cat0, fm.group_id, fm.market_tier, fm.canonical_market_key, fm.resolution_date::date AS res, (fm.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS img, fm.volume_24h, (SELECT o.name||' '||round(o.current_probability::numeric,3) FROM futures_outcomes o WHERE o.market_id=fm.id AND o.current_probability IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.current_probability DESC LIMIT 1) AS leader, (SELECT count(*) FROM futures_outcomes o WHERE o.market_id=fm.id) AS n_out FROM futures_markets fm WHERE fm.status='open' AND fm.name ~* '\m(met gala|oscars?|academy awards?|grammys?|emmys?)\M' ORDER BY fm.market_tier NULLS LAST, fm.volume_24h DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 400
